field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Include unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF for current LLM work; [] for no current LLM work. Record small Gibbs training separately.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Expected/observed/operator/passed separated for required validation, safety, completion and scientific efficacy; no equality substituted for >=.
field_principles.active_exact_contract_count: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.active_research_roadmap_changed: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.checkpoint_path: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.contract_complete_score: One only when both authorities and all relevant checks agree; advisory, never a science gate.
field_principles.contract_passed: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.contract_rows: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured monotonic duration, never invented time or sleep to meet a floor.
field_principles.execution_venue: Exactly host in V648. This is a closed string, never host_cpu, a device name or a dictionary; put device details in inference_substrate.
field_principles.experiment_id: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.external_publication_authorized: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.field_principles: Explain every output field without wrapping ordinary dictionaries or numeric gate values.
field_principles.flagged_adversarial: True for a critical independent finding; excludes producer from readiness gates.
field_principles.fresh_id_rows: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.fresh_ids_passed: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked_* names the failed check/upstream, exact field/path, expected value and observed value, including missing or None.
field_principles.gate_control_rows: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.gate_declaration_result: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.historical_boundary: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.historical_inference_sidecars: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed work uses complete_ or complete: with precise scope; blocked_* names an unavailable prerequisite.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Actual CPU/JAX or owned native CUDA computation, device identity and resource lease; historical provenance stays labeled.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Closed class matching the actual current computation and authentic duration; no padding.
field_principles.inference_substrate_details: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Attempted/completed/failed/cancelled/in-flight current LLM loads and generations, with raw receipts; no historical calls counted as current.
field_principles.llm_invocation_receipts: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.markdown_id_order: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.markdown_milestone: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.markdown_task_rows: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.milestone: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.model_invoked: True for any attempted current LLM load or generation, even a failed attempt; distinguish small EBM training.
field_principles.mutation_rows: Private changed contract and actual rejecting check.
field_principles.passed: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.phase: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Exact paths, producer identity/hash/class and resource checks before dependent work.
field_principles.production_defaults_changed: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.promotion_score: Always zero: no automatic production rollout, generator weight change or external publication.
field_principles.random_seed: Frozen experiment and resampling seeds; null only when not applicable.
field_principles.raw_authority_rows: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.repository_health: Dated unrelated failures distinct from required affected checks; never hide affected failures.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind exact code, settings, protocol, data/source versions and raw rows.
field_principles.required_checks_passed: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.research_conductor_changed: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.retirement_declaration_result: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.rows: Every unit/arm/seed outcome, metric, cost, failure and censoring disposition behind comparative claims.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260918 plus actual start/end UTC timestamps.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Predeclared planned/attempted/completed/censored/unstarted units, stopping rules and remaining work.
field_principles.schema: Versioned schema with ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.small_ebm_training: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.source_access_rows: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.source_access_sidecar: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Exact producer paths and byte hashes; preserve original verdicts and flags.
field_principles.source_method_rows: Primary URL, checked date, adopted control or defer reason, and access status.
field_principles.started_at_utc: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.status: Terminal only after actual work and required validation; no success-shaped bootstrap artifact.
field_principles.study_mapping_ingested: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.validation_plan_errors: This field keeps one part of the V648 receipt auditable.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Executed argv/environment/scope/return code/duration/log hash, including failures and exact required-check list.
field_principles.verdict_class: Exactly positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Oracle-positive claims are circular_positive. Only retryable unfinished OWN work is partial; unchanged external absence is blocked.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True when formal evaluator defines truth; independently coded oracle checks do not remove circularity.
